blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — Lapu-Lapu City is set to conduct monthly monitoring of its city-funded infrastructure projects to track implementation, address delays and ensure that projects are completed on schedule. Mayor Cindi King Chan led a project monitoring meeting on Wednesday, October 1, where city officials reviewed the status of ongoing infrastructure projects and discussed concerns affecting their implementation. The meeting was attended by representatives from the City Engineering Office, led by Engr. Sharon Baguio; the City Planning and Development Office; and DILG Lapu-Lapu City Director Dr. Neila Aquino, along with representatives from other offices involved in project implementation and monitoring.
